Short-circuit protection for all types of faults in effectively earthed
 power transmission systems.

Completely static design of all measuring and logic circuits with contact
 outputs for tripping and remote signaling.

Duplicate-channel construction of measuring and logic circuits and
 duplicate-channel control of the trip relays.

On-line measuring systems arranged to continuously monitor the power
 system quantities.

Of them have an offset quadrilateral impedance characteristic; the
 remaining 6 have a quadrilateral impedance characteristic and use
 cross-polarization techniques for directional measurement.

Optimum matching to the fault parameters; the polygon-shaped tripping
 areas provide high fault sensitivity combined with exceptional stability
 against load encroachment and power swings.
Shortest tripping time typically 12 ms.

The measurement is based upon a duplex block-block coincidence measuring
 principle. This technique enables half-cycle minimum operating time combined
 with accuracy and inherent stability against interference and adverse
 transients.

Separate and independent setting of reach along the R-and X-axis for each
 measuring element allows:
Compensation of unequal phase-impedances on non-transposed lines.

Setting of high R-to X ratios on phase-to-ground units where high fault
 resistance compensation may be necessary.

Setting of small R-to-X ratios on phase-to-phase units where load
 encroachment may be a problem but high fault resistances are not to be
 expected.

Healthy phase or memory voltage polarized directional measurement provides
 unlimited directional sensitivity for terminal faults.

Impedance measuring characteristics and tripping logic are designed to
 provide phase-selective starting and tripping commands for single-pole auto
 reclosing schemes.

Single-pole or three-pole tripping of single-phase-to-ground faults can be
 plug-selected.

Time-delayed back-up distance zones three of which are directional forward
 zones;

The remaining one being a zone with an offset characteristic and with
 separate settings for forward and reverse reach.

The hardware is of plug-in modular construction. It forms part of a series
 of highly compatible, standardized distance protection schemes (7SL13,
 7SL24, 7SL40).

Relay inputs are provided for blocking or zone-extension from external
 sources

A built-in directional test feature allows a directional check of the
 measuring systems this feature is particularly helpful to verify the correct
 polarity of C.T. and VT connections.

Dead fault protection is incorporated and enables instantaneous tripping
 of the offset distance zone when switching onto a dead fault.

DC/DC converter for supply of static circuits, the operating principle of
 which of which permits a wide station battery voltage variation.

The distance protection is rewired for a range of frequently
 ruined supplementary functions:

Measured voltage monitor 7TU32; (Fuse failure detector) monitors
 continuously the V.T secondary voltages for short-circuits and
 open-circuits.

Instantaneous short-circuit trip 7TJ15; practically independent of d.c.
 component (transient free) it enables a current grading in the case of long
 lines both with and without series capacitors.

Power swing auxiliary 7TL16 + 7TW42; prevents distance protection tripping
 due to power swing and can also be used for intentional selective
 de-coupling of network sections undergoing power swings.

Phase memory 7TF2; enables a correct directional measurement even for
 faults behind series capacitors.
A comprehensive range of supplementary functions is available.
Tele-protection interfaces 7SW11.
For all transferred tripping, and unblocking schemes
Auto re-closing schemes 7vk3.
Single-pole or three-pole, one-shot or multi-shot.
Parallel line auxiliary 7SM11.

Compensates the influence of inductive coupling of the zero-sequence
 systems in the case of parallel lines.
Distance-to-fault locator 7SE10,
Operating with a digital calculator
Test-combination 7XV66,

Which isolates the VT and CT inputs in the test position and enables
 secondary injection testing via a standard test plug.
